title: MetaObjects template-codegen spec
description: Declarative Mustache template-generator spec (SP-1). Consumed by the CLI ports (C#/Python) and TS.

data.description: What the template reads: the per-entity dictionary (default) or the docs view (docs/features/docs-view.md). perNode and perRequirement read only the docs view.

match.description: perNode and perRequirement: which kinds get a page, as <type>.<subType>, <type>.* or *.

subDir.description: The directory under the target the output paths, and a docs-view page's root, are relative to.

assets.description: A directory of static text files, relative to the project, copied under subDir.

linkCheck.description: Fail the run when a relative link in this entry's HTML pages lands on no file or anchor.
